goal: Implement Live Paper Trading Runner and Execution Adapter for Auto Trader BETA with real-time multi-asset brain evaluation, continuous compounding lifecycle, and safety kill switch

contracts.interfaces: export interface ExecutionAdapter { executeBuy(request: any): Promise<any>; executeSell(request: any): Promise<any>; getPosition(): any; }

execution_steps: Write PaperExecutionAdapter in frontend/src/lib/paperExecutionAdapter.ts with configurable feeRate, slippage, and execution logging

Write AutoTraderRunner in frontend/src/lib/autoTraderRunner.ts with live Binance data ingestion, quantitative brain integration, WebSocket position monitoring, compounding continuity, kill switch, and persistence
Write 13 automated tests in frontend/src/__tests__/auto_trader_live_paper.test.js covering all required edge cases
Run npm run build --prefix frontend and npx oxlint
Run live paper trading session script against live Binance data and produce comprehensive report
acceptance_criteria: PaperExecutionAdapter enforces configurable feeRate and realistic slippage without hidden costs
AutoTraderRunner executes full autonomous cycle: Scan -> Analyze -> Risk Check -> Paper Buy -> WebSocket Monitor -> Paper Sell -> Compounding -> Rescan
No trades are forced; system logs NO TRADE / WAIT / AVOID when market does not meet criteria
Kill switch safely halts execution on stale data, NaN, negative capital, or corrupt state
State persistence prevents duplicate position on restart
All 13 automated tests pass with exit code 0
definition_of_done: commands.test returns exit code 0 for all 13 tests
Zero private Binance API or real money endpoints are used
Live paper run executes successfully with real Binance data and outputs structured metrics
